title: iDeal Platform System API Reference
summary: Complete API reference for iDeal trading platform (Sezai Kılıç). Covers order management (EmirSembol, EmirIslem, EmirTipi, EmirMiktari, EmirFiyati, EmirSuresi, EmirGonder), VİOP functions (ViopHesapOku, RobotViopAktif), position tracking (PozisyonKontrolOku/Guncelle), state management (SayiTablosu, SozcukTablosu), real-time data (SonFiyat, AlisFiyat, SatisFiyat, YuzeyselVeriOku, KademeAnalizOku, DerinlikVerisiOku), technical indicators (100+ indicators), robot framework, query system, and optimization module.
